existing_requirement: Any registered user can delete their own posts.
The system shall be available 24/7 with no scheduled downtime.
new_requirement: The system shall undergo scheduled maintenance every Sunday from 2-4 AM.

existing_requirement: All user data shall be publicly viewable by default.
new_requirement: User data shall be private and visible only to the user.

existing_requirement: The system shall allow guest checkout without creating an account.
new_requirement: Users must create an account before making a purchase.

existing_requirement: The system shall only accept payments in USD.
new_requirement: The system shall reject any payment not made in EUR.

existing_requirement: Users shall be limited to uploading files up to 5MB.
new_requirement: Users shall be able to upload files up to 50MB.

existing_requirement: The mobile app shall work fully offline with no internet required.
new_requirement: The mobile app requires an active internet connection for all features.

existing_requirement: There should be a written agreement to satisfy users that the service they are providing will be returned.
new_requirement: The system shall provide a platform for users to exchange digital services on demand, with no restrictions on service type and no predefined deadlines.

existing_requirement: Users can reset their password via email.
The system shall send email notifications for new messages.
new_requirement: The system shall send SMS notifications for payment confirmations.

existing_requirement: Admins can view all user reports.
new_requirement: Regular users can only view their own reports.

existing_requirement: The system shall support English as the default language.
new_requirement: The system shall allow users to switch the interface to French.

existing_requirement: The dashboard shall display the last 10 transactions.
new_requirement: The dashboard shall show a chart of monthly spending.

existing_requirement: The app shall automatically lower volume in noisy environments.
new_requirement: The app shall provide a 'party mode' for shared playlists.

existing_requirement: Students can view posts about admissions from multiple universities.
new_requirement: Students can share posts with each other.
